title: The president who cried tariffs: will the US supreme court challenge Trump’s trade war?
summary: The US high court will hear arguments on whether Trump’s erratic imposition of global tariffs is legally validDonald Trump thrives on emergencies. He cried havoc on the very first day of his second term, declaring a national emergency caused by an “invasion” of “illegal aliens” from Mexico. He has since invoked emergencies more than any president since the passage of the National Emergencies Act in 1976.Next Wednesday, he faces another of his own making, as the US supreme court hears oral arguments on whether his globe-shaking signature economic policy – tariffs – is legally valid.Continue reading...

title: Snap surges 20% on Q3 revenue beat, $500M buyback, and $400M AI partnership with Perplexity
summary: Edit: Surges 20% after-hoursNo paywall:https://www.cnbc.com/2025/11/05/snap-q3-earnings-report-2025.htmlSnap on Wednesday issued its third-quarter earnings, reporting revenue that beat analysts expectations and announcing a $500 million stock repurchase program.In a letter, Snap said that new policies around the globe, including Australia’s social media minimum age bill, may result in a decline of daily active users in the fourth quarter.Snap also announced that Perplexity AI will pay the social media company $400 million over one year to integrate the artificial intelligence startup’s search features into Snapchat.submitted by/u/callsonreddit[link][comments]
